answer: APAC's completed revenue fell by 53.76% from Q2 to Q3 2025, driven primarily by the number of orders, which was the largest contributor and fell by 28.57%. In comparison, the number of orders in other regions changed by an average of -8.18%. Meanwhile, the average order value fell by 35.26% in APAC, while it changed across other regions within a range of -37.04% to -32.30%. Because other components changed by a similar amount in every group, they do not explain the difference, however large their own changes were.
